cases.question: How much quarterly rebate do distributors receive?
cases.answer: Eligible distributors receive a quarterly volume rebate of 2% when qualified quarterly sell-through exceeds EUR 200,000. The 2% rebate is calculated on eligible net product value after approved discounts, returns, credits, and excluded promotional items. (Source: Rebate Policy)

cases.question: What information is needed for distributor onboarding?
cases.answer: A new distributor must complete business verification before commercial orders can be processed. Required information includes the registered company name, registration number, tax information, billing contact, shipping contact, authorized purchasing contact, and approved sales channels. (Source: Distributor Onboarding)

cases.question: When must delivery problems be reported?
cases.answer: Delivery problems, including missing cartons, visible transport damage, incorrect quantities, or incorrect products, must be reported within 72 hours after receipt. A delivery problem report must contain the purchase order number, shipment reference, affected SKU, affected quantity, description of the problem, and supporting photographs when relevant. (Source: Delivery and Logistics)

cases.question: What warranty applies to robotic vacuum products?
cases.answer: Eligible robotic vacuum products include a two-year limited warranty from the applicable consumer purchase date, subject to the fictional terms of this demonstration handbook. Warranty coverage does not include deliberate damage, unauthorized modification, unsupported repair, misuse, or damage caused by operation outside published product requirements. (Source: Warranty Policy)

cases.question: What is required before returning products with an RMA?
cases.answer: Products must not be returned without an approved Return Merchandise Authorization, also referred to as an RMA. The distributor must provide the product serial number, purchase reference, reason for return, product condition, and requested resolution. (Source: Returns and RMA)

cases.question: What happens to overdue payment balances?
cases.answer: Payment terms are defined in the distributor agreement and commercial account setup. Overdue balances may result in order suspension or credit review. (Source: Payment Terms)

cases.question: Where may distributors actively market products?
cases.answer: New products may be subject to launch confidentiality, allocation limits, embargo rules, and approved announcement timing. A distributor must not publish confidential launch information before the authorized announcement. (Source: Product Launches)

cases.question: What must an online marketplace listing identify?
cases.answer: Sales through online marketplaces are permitted only where the marketplace or seller account is included within the distributor's approved commercial scope. Marketplace listings must accurately identify the product, condition, included accessories, and seller. (Source: Online Marketplace Policy)

cases.question: What information must purchase orders contain?
cases.answer: Each purchase order must contain the distributor account identifier, product SKU, requested quantity, billing information, shipping destination, and purchasing contact. Duplicate purchase orders must be reported immediately to the account manager. (Source: Purchase Orders)

cases.question: How should distributors use trademarks and brand identifiers?
cases.answer: The distributor must use trademarks and brand identifiers in accordance with approved brand guidelines. Suspected counterfeit products or unauthorized use of brand assets may be reported to the partner account manager. (Source: Brand Protection)
